symmGroup.statement: Definition. Let $\Omega$ be a measure space with measure $P$, and let $G$ be an additive abelian group with a measurable space structure for which addition $G\times G\to G$ is measurable. For a measurable map $X:\Omega\to G$, $\mathrm{Sym}[X]$ (the project's `symmGroup X`) is the additive subgroup of $G$ whose underlying set is $\{h\in G:\ X\text{ and }\omega\mapsto X(\omega)+h\text{ are identically distributed with respect to }P\}$, i.e. the set of all $h\in G$ such that $X+h$ has the same law under $P$ as $X$ (this set is closed under addition, contains $0$ and is closed under negation). According to its docstring, it is the symmetry group of $X$.
